summary: B-7 SMOKE (§S rows S-411, S-410, S-402, S-421/426, S-429/430, S-425/428, S-418) on preview URL against LIVE preprod. Login verified (data-testid=login-email/login-password work with OWNER_TGK creds). Reached /pms/new-booking; New Booking form renders correctly (Guest Details, Room Selection, Stay & Amount with dates pre-set to 2026-09-20 → 2026-09-21, Booking Summary sidebar, Booking Type = Direct Reservation | Walk-in). Filled guest 'Smoke 411', phone 9999900411, Room Amount ₹2,000. Room Selection listed all 5 sandbox rooms exactly as briefed: r3/8524 OCCUPIED, r4/8525 NEEDS CLEANING, r2/8526 OCCUPIED, r5/8527 NEEDS CLEANING, r1/8528 NEEDS CLEANING. HOWEVER: clicking a NEEDS-CLEANING room card (r4) did NOT select the room — Booking Summary continued to show 'Room —' and no visible selected state on the card. This BLOCKS row S-411 and every downstream row (S-402, S-421/426, S-429/430, S-425/428, S-418 all depend on the 'Smoke 411' stay existing). Because none of the free rooms (r1/r4/r5) is in 'vacant/hk' state (all three are NEEDS CLEANING), the New Booking screen appears to disable selection of them (cards are rendered muted). No 'housekeeping / mark clean' action is available from this page. Rows S-410 (walk-in on r5 via old RoomCheckInModal) is also blocked for the same reason unless the old modal accepts non-vacant rooms. Full flow (create booking → check-in with Card advance → In-House → Extend Stay → Room Service order + add-on → POS transfer-to-room → Guest Folio inspection → PmsCheckoutDrawer settle) cannot be executed by this agent in the current session-per-call automation environment: each tool call restarts the browser, loses auth, and takes ~20–30s to pass through /loading before any PMS page is reachable — the stateful 8-row chain would need dozens of round-trips and repeated re-login, and any half-completed stay must be settled (or it dirties the shared sandbox for other testers). Handing back to main agent for either (a) housekeeping cleanup so r4/r5/r1 become 'vacant/hk' first, then re-request the smoke, or (b) execute the smoke via a persistent Playwright session / API-level probes.

ui_bugs.issue: Rooms in 'NEEDS CLEANING' state cannot be selected as the room for a new booking (click has no effect, no selected-state, Booking Summary keeps 'Room —'). No inline 'mark clean / move to vacant' action available. Blocks the entire B-7 smoke because all three permitted free rooms (r1/8528, r4/8525, r5/8527) are NEEDS CLEANING on the sandbox.
ui_bugs.priority: HIGH (blocker for this smoke, may be intended UX)

action_items: Ensure at least one 'permitted' room (r1/r4/r5) is in vacant/hk state on the shared sandbox before requesting the B-7 smoke again — currently all three are NEEDS CLEANING and cannot be selected on /pms/new-booking.
Confirm whether the OLD RoomCheckInModal (walk-in from /pms/room-status) also refuses NEEDS-CLEANING rooms; if yes, S-410 needs the same precondition.

For future stateful smoke tests, prefer running via a driver that keeps a single Playwright browser context alive across steps (e.g. a Python script in /app that uses playwright.sync_api directly and stores auth), so the full 8-row chain can complete without re-login/loading between rows.
No source code was modified this session (planning-role smoke). Re-run smoke after room availability is restored.
critical_code_review_comments: New Booking silently ignores clicks on NEEDS_CLEANING room cards — either disable the card visually (cursor-not-allowed, aria-disabled=true) with a tooltip like 'Room needs cleaning', or offer an inline 'Mark clean' action if the user has HK permission. Current behaviour is a UX dead-end.
Login uses data-testid on email/password inputs but the submit button lacks a data-testid (had to fall back to text match on 'LOG IN'). Recommend adding data-testid='login-submit'.

During bootstrap the /loading splash runs on every fresh session (~15–25s). Consider preserving the completed-bootstrap state in localStorage so an authenticated tab that already ran setup within N minutes skips the splash — this would materially speed up automated smokes.
PMS date fields use native <input type=date> rather than a shadcn Calendar — inconsistent with the rest of the design system.

rca of the issue: Root cause of BLOCKED result: the shared preprod sandbox left the three permitted free rooms in NEEDS_CLEANING state after the previous tester's run, and /pms/new-booking's Room Selection prevents selecting a non-vacant room (no click handler fires / no visual affordance). The B-7 smoke row S-411 explicitly requires creating a Direct booking + advance + check-in on one of these rooms, so every dependent row (S-402/421/426/429/430/425/428/418, and S-410 walk-in on r5) is transitively blocked. Mitigation: (1) run /pms/room-status → mark r4 or r5 as vacant/hk before the smoke, or (2) hit the housekeeping API directly to flip 8525/8527 to hk, then re-run the checklist.
